:::{#cor-var-mse-bias}
#### Standard error squared equals pMSE minus squared bias

The squared standard error is what remains of the pMSE
after the squared bias is removed:

$$\sqf{\SE{\hparam}} = \mselr{\hparam} - \sqf{\bias{\hparam}}$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-var-mse-bias.

:::
